# sf-intelligence — marketing & docs site (Astro)

The product's public site, rebuilt on **Astro** (static output). Deploys to
**Cloudflare Pages**. The framework buys reusable components, a typed data pipeline, an auto-generated priority
sitemap, and a single SEO component so every page ships correct
canonical/OG/JSON-LD by construction.

> Ships **no product source and no org data** — Cloudflare serves only `dist/`,
> which is built from `src/` + `public/`. The product source never enters the
> output.

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm run dev          # http://localhost:4321
npm run build        # → dist/  (static)
npm run verify-markup            # gate over dist/: tables, titles ≤ 60, llms.txt coverage
npm run preview -- --port 4455   # serve the build
npm run crawl-test   # crawler + 360/390px overflow gate against the running preview
                     # (pass a base URL if 4455 is taken: node scripts/crawl-test.mjs http://localhost:4456)
```

## Structure

```
src/
  data/site.ts            Brand/URL/identity constants (one source of truth)
  data/site-data.json     COMPUTED numbers (tool count, core count, concepts, tests…) — from recalibrate.mjs
  data/tools.json         Tool registry grouped by the product's own categories — from recalibrate.mjs
  data/lastmod.json       Each route's last content change, from git history — from recalibrate.mjs
  data/llms-header.md     The hand-written top of llms.txt; {{tokens}} filled from site-data.json
  components/SeoHead.astro Every page's <head>: title/canonical/OG/Twitter/JSON-LD @graph
  components/Header,Footer Shared nav/footer (incl. visible GitHub link)
  layouts/Base.astro      html/head/body shell; inlines the CSS
  layouts/DocPage.astro   Base + breadcrumb sub-hero for content pages
  pages/*.astro           One file per route (use-cases/ and compare/ are nested)
  pages/tools.json.ts     /tools.json — the catalog for agents and directories
  styles/style.css        Design tokens + components (light and dark)
integrations/geo.mjs      Build hook: writes dist/llms.txt + llms-full.txt from the built pages
public/                   Verbatim assets: robots.txt, _headers, _redirects, site.webmanifest,
                          assets/img/, fonts/, .well-known/mcp/server.json, GSC verify file
scripts/crawl-test.mjs    Crawlability + phone-width overflow gate (headless Chrome, no deps)
scripts/verify-markup.mjs Markup gate over dist/
scripts/render-og.mjs     Renders scripts/og-card.html → public/assets/img/og-image.png
recalibrate.mjs           Regenerates the data files from the built product
```

## Recalibrate (the numbers)

Every computed number is derived from the **product source**, not hand-typed.
Run this from the product repo (it imports `packages/mcp/dist`) — it does NOT
run in Cloudflare's build (Cloudflare only sees this folder):

```sh
# product must be built first: (cd .. && pnpm -r build)
node recalibrate.mjs
```

It writes `src/data/site-data.json`, `src/data/tools.json`,
`src/data/lastmod.json` and `public/.well-known/mcp/server.json` (a copy of
`packages/cli/server.json`). Astro renders every number from those files; never
type a count into a page (`pnpm doc-sync` in the product repo fails on stale
count phrases in `src/pages`). Run it before every deploy that follows a
product release, and after page edits you want reflected in sitemap `lastmod`.

`llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt` and `/tools.json` are generated by `npm run build`,
so a new page is listed automatically. `recalibrate.mjs` fails if more than 5
tools land in the "Other" group: place a new tool family in the product's
capability map or in `NAME_RULES`.

`sitemap lastmod` comes only from `lastmod.json`. Cloudflare clones shallow, so
the build never asks git; a route that is not in the file gets no `lastmod`.

After a hero copy change, re-render the share card: `node scripts/render-og.mjs`.

## Cloudflare Pages settings (CHANGE from the old static config)

The old site had no build step. Astro needs one:

| Setting | Old | New |
|---|---|---|
| Root directory | `website` | `website` (unchanged) |
| Framework preset | None | None (static Astro needs no adapter) |
| Build command | *(empty)* | `npm run build` |
| Build output directory | `/` | `dist` |
| Node version | — | `22` (`.nvmrc` present) |

`public/_headers` (cache/security) and the GSC verification file carry over
verbatim. `functions/_middleware.js` redirects the `salesforce-intelligence.pages.dev`
host to the canonical domain: Pages `_redirects` cannot match on hostname, so
keep it until that redirect moves to a Cloudflare Bulk Redirect. `404.astro` is auto-served by Cloudflare on unmatched routes.

**Web Analytics readiness:** `_headers` CSP allows
`https://static.cloudflareinsights.com` in `script-src` and
`'self' https://cloudflareinsights.com` in `connect-src` — the minimum for
Cloudflare Web Analytics' beacon (auto-inject via `/cdn-cgi/rum` or manual
embed). Enabling the dashboard toggle remains a separate maintainer step; this
only prevents a silent CSP block once it is flipped.

## SEO / crawler gate

`npm run crawl-test` asserts, for every sitemap URL: 200 · one self-canonical ·
one index H1 · valid JSON-LD · no noindex · description in range · og/twitter
present · title ≤ 60 · every internal link resolves · no orphan pages · robots
welcomes AI crawlers · no horizontal overflow at 360px and 390px (headless
Chrome; `--no-layout` skips it explicitly). Wire it into CI on any change to this folder, and run it post-deploy
against the live URL.
